description: This source file implements the interface for inter-process communication (IPC) with a file system monitor daemon, providing functions to check support, retrieve daemon path, get IPC state, and send queries/commands. It includes a fallback stub implementation for unsupported platforms and the main implementation that manages daemon spawning and communication with the daemon.

methods.name: int fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported(void)
methods.description: Returns 1 if the IPC system is supported on the current platform, otherwise 0.

methods.name: const char * fsmonitor_ipc__get_path(struct repository * r UNUSED)
methods.description: Returns the path to the FSMonitor daemon for the given repository, or NULL if unsupported.

methods.name: enum:ipc_active_state fsmonitor_ipc__get_state(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the current IPC active state for the FSMonitor daemon.

methods.name: int fsmonitor_ipc__send_query(const char * since_token UNUSED,struct strbuf * answer UNUSED)
methods.description: Sends a query to the FSMonitor daemon with an optional since_token, receives response in answer buffer.

methods.name: int fsmonitor_ipc__send_command(const char * command UNUSED,struct strbuf * answer UNUSED)
methods.description: Sends a command string to the FSMonitor daemon and receives the response.
